DXVK 3.1.1, the official release (github.com/doitsujin/dxvk), zlib/libpng. (3.1 until 2026-09-19.)

x32/d3d9.dll is dxvk-3.1.1/x32/d3d9.dll extracted unmodified from the owner's
dxvk-3.1.1.tar.gz (18,041,512 bytes, MD5 dfca4e1ee1399ebd365c1b1b919dc78a,
file dated 2026-09-17): 7,856,142 bytes, MD5 093943dbadc00725ed39bb25b22c9dfa,
and it names itself v3.1.1. It is byte for byte the vulkan.dll the owner has
played on in both game folders. THE SAME SIZE TO THE BYTE AS 3.1's
(MD5 3069b49c82640b7b1f252ca58fe89ead): only the hash tells the two apart.
VENDORED NOT COMMITTED (.gitignore);
package.ps1 verifies the size and MD5 before it ships it.

IT SHIPS AS vulkan.dll, NOT d3d9.dll. On a FusionFix install d3d9.dll is
FusionFix's own D3D9 proxy: it reads d3d9.cfg ([MAIN] API = 1) and loads DXVK
under the name vulkan.dll. Shipping ours overwrites FusionFix's bundled copy,
by the owner's decision on 2026-09-10.

Verified before it was adopted (docs/OUTSTANDING-2026-09-10.md, section 3):
every DXVK interface the mod uses has the same GUID, method order and
parameters in 3.1 as in source/dxvk/dxvk_interop_min.h and hdr_encode.h; a
full session ran clean on it; the HDR staircase passed on it.

THE MOD ITSELF accepts any 3.1.x (DLSS-IV.cpp, LogDxvkVersion: "3.1" then end or
a dot), so nothing in the code moved with this.

LICENSE-DXVK.txt is DXVK's LICENSE at tag v3.1, AND IT IS v3.1.1's TOO. Checked
2026-09-19 against raw.githubusercontent.com/doitsujin/dxvk/v3.1.1/LICENSE:
upstream's file is byte for byte the same at both tags (1,074 bytes, MD5
e1c22399f5cab679bedf6fb87b8ed4a4), and this copy is that text with CRLF line
endings and nothing else different.
It was fetched 2026-09-10 from
raw.githubusercontent.com/doitsujin/dxvk/v3.1/LICENSE (1,074 bytes). The
release tarball carries no licence file, so this is the copy that travels.
